svg.aria-label: Oxigraph: overhead of moving results into JavaScript against the number of results
svg.text: Oxigraph: overhead of moving results into JavaScript against the number of results
Each point is a benchmark query instance; overhead = full − count, measured per query. Dashed:
the cost per result measured on the calibration scans. Points far above the lines are differences
between the COUNT and plain plans or run-to-run noise, not transfer. Instances without results or
with an overhead at or below zero cannot be shown on log axes. cloud-4vcpu
chromium: fit over these queries -0.74 µs per result, R² 0.01
